audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Vladimir Levels 2-3 and called Level 1 and Levels 4-6 Skill, while whys[0..3] all describe Wukong bullying him and whys[4] hands Level 6 to Vladimir.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Wukong for rows 0-3 and Vladimir for rows 4-6, matching the prose exactly. The mirror audit (vladimir__wukong) records the same direction of correction — rows 0-2 to Wukong and row 4 to Vladimir.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-3 set to Wukong and row 4 to Vladimir as matched phases[N].side + win[N] pairs, all seven ratings normalised, and the five stage explanations rewritten to state the mechanical reason.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why was boilerplate claiming Cyclone's knockup wins every committed brawl, on the row where the matchup actually turns against you.
audit.why: Hemoplague is a 120s, 625-range zone that increases the damage infected enemies take and then heals Vladimir for every champion hit. Combined with Transfusion falling from 9s to 4.6s at max rank, Level 6 is his spike, not yours.
audit.corrected: Level 6 stage now names Hemoplague's damage amplification and per-champion heal as the reason the phase flips; the Levels 1-3 stages now name Transfusion's 9s rank-1 cooldown and Sanguine Pool's 28s as Wukong's actual spikes.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2] 'Build MR + anti-heal', dontsFull[1] 'Stack pure HP' and dontsFull[2] 'Let him free-scale' all carried bodies copied from other rows and matching none of their headings. Tides of Blood being blocked by units was absent, and no real cooldown appeared anywhere.
audit.why: Riot's own text says Tides of Blood 'can be blocked by enemy units', so standing behind your minions denies his poke outright. Crimson Pact converts bonus health into AP, which is why raw HP is the wrong answer and MR is the right one. Both Transfusion and Hemoplague heal, so Grievous Wounds has to land before the commit.
audit.corrected: dosFull[2].d now names both healing sources; dontsFull[1].d names Crimson Pact; dontsFull[2].d states the Transfusion cooldown decay as the scaling clock; breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d carry Pool's 2s untargetable on 28s, Transfusion's 9s-to-4.6s, and the minion-block rule.

edits.before: Q-AA poke wins the short exchanges. Identify how Vladimir contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Transfusion is 9s at rank 1 and he has no Pool yet — walk up the moment his Q lands and take the trade.

edits.before: W clone bails out any misstep and baits his answer. Only take the trade when Vladimir's Sanguine Pool is down.
edits.after: Still no escape for him at 2: he pays his own health for Tides of Blood, so every poke he throws makes your all-in cheaper.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Vladimir must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Full kit online against a Sanguine Pool that is 28s at rank 1 — once he spends it he has nothing left to answer you with.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Sanguine Pool's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Your last clean window: stand behind your minions so Tides of Blood is blocked, then engage on the 28s Pool and freeze him off farm.

edits.before: Cyclone’s double knockup wins every committed brawl. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Vladimir's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Hemoplague amplifies the damage you take and heals him for every champion it hits, so from 6 his sustain outlasts your commit.

edits.before: - Vladimir Sanguine Pool: matchup-defining — Dodges your burst. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Sanguine Pool: 2s untargetable on 28s at rank 1 — the window that decides the lane. - Transfusion: 9s early, 4.6s maxed, so his sustain improves every rank. - Tides of Blood: units block it, so stand behind minions.

edits.before: Dodges your burst. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 2s untargetable on a 28s clock at rank 1 — bait it, then commit.

edits.before: Vladimir wastes Sanguine Pool — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Transfusion and Hemoplague both heal him — Grievous Wounds first.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Crimson Pact turns bonus health into AP for him — build MR instead.

edits.before: Burning W before the trade starts — the clone IS your defense, and committing without it means eating his full combo.
edits.after: Every calm minute drops his Transfusion cooldown toward 4.6s — force the lane before 6 or you never get the window back.
